prompt: Write a Python class OrphanGuard that monitors child processes. Constructor takes a list of (child_pid, parent_pid) tuples. Method check_orphans() returns a sorted list of child_pids whose parent is no longer alive (i.e., parent_pid not found as any entry's child_pid in the monitored set). Also provide reap_orphans() that prints 'REAP <pid>' for each orphaned child. Helper: treat parent_pid -1 as 'root' (always alive). Use only the tuple data as ground truth (no actual OS process calls, no external libraries).
